{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes, especially when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Adjust forecasts downward if recent true outcomes show persistent mean reversion toward lower levels after high peaks.",
    "Apply downward bias correction when sentiment history includes multiple negative entries (e.g., >2 consecutive negative sentiment values).",
    "Increase downward adjustment magnitude when true outcomes consistently lag behind forecasts in the first 5–7 days of the 30-day horizon.",
    "If sentiment turns negative after a peak, reduce forecasted price by 5–10% of the peak value to account for downward momentum.",
    "Avoid overreacting to short-term volatility; use 3–5 day moving average of true outcomes to smooth out noise before forecasting.",
    "When sentiment is positive but true outcomes are consistently below forecasts, apply a 3–5% downward correction to prevent overconfidence in upward momentum."
  ]
}
